query: SELECT MIN(CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(filename, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)) as min_num, MAX(CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(filename, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)) as max_num, COUNT(*) as total FROM photos WHERE category = 'event' AND filename LIKE 'tenue officielle%' AND status = 'approved';
